description: ./bin/dx help. The help text embeds the live 'bun run --help' flag catalog, so it is a direct probe of the runtime's CLI surface (a Bun bump that adds/removes/renames a flag shows up here as a diff). Throwaway HOME; no network. The DX_VERIFY_RUNTIME guard itself is covered by verify-bun-fake-pin and tests/toolchain_verify_bun.test.ts.
